# gtm_built_in_variables (Data Source)

Lists all the enabled Built-In Variables of a GTM Container.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent` (String) GTM Workspace's API relative path.

### Optional

- `all_pages` (Boolean) Follow next_page_token until every page has been retrieved. Defaults to true.
- `page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

### Read-Only

- `built_in_variable_json` (String) All GTM BuiltInVariables of a GTM container.
- `next_page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.
